content.title: Dell leads S&P 500 gains, Nvidia CEO confirms xAI investment
content.description:
Yahoo Finance's John Hyland tracks Wednesday's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute.

Dell (DELL) stock's price target was upgraded by multiple firms, including JPMorgan (JPM), Citi (C), and UBS (UBS).

Gold (GC=F) continues to rally, trading above the $4,000 mark.

Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang confirmed in a CNBC interview on Wednesday that the company will be investing in Tesla (TSLA) CEO Elon Musk's artificial intelligence company, xAI (XAAI.PVT).

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.
